description: This file implements a Telnet backend for Zephyr's shell, including network setup, command handling, and data transmission.

methods.name: telnet_end_client_connection
methods.description: Closes the current telnet client connection, releases resources, and flushes receive FIFO.

methods.name: telnet_sent_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked after data is sent; ends connection on error.

methods.name: telnet_command_send_reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message over the telnet connection.

methods.name: telnet_reply_ay_command
methods.description: Replies with a 'Zephyr at your service' message.

methods.name: telnet_echo_set
methods.description: Enables or disables echo on the shell.

methods.name: telnet_reply_dont_command
methods.description: Handles 'DONT' telnet commands, especially for ECHO option.

methods.name: telnet_reply_do_command
methods.description: Handles 'DO' telnet commands, especially for SUPR_GA and ECHO options.

methods.name: telnet_reply_command
methods.description: Processes incoming telnet commands and responds accordingly.

methods.name: telnet_send
methods.description: Sends buffered data over the network connection.

methods.name: telnet_send_prematurely
methods.description: Work handler to trigger sending data.

methods.name: telnet_handle_command
methods.description: Parses and handles telnet command packets.

methods.name: telnet_recv
methods.description: Receives data packets, processes commands, and queues data.

methods.name: telnet_accept
methods.description: Handles new incoming telnet client connections.

methods.name: telnet_setup_server
methods.description: Initializes server socket, binds, listens, and accepts connections.

methods.name: telnet_init
methods.description: Initializes telnet server on IPv4 and IPv6 if enabled.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the telnet shell transport, sets up network and state.

methods.name: uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes the transport (placeholder).

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the transport (placeholder).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the telnet connection, buffering and scheduling send.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the receive FIFO.

methods.name: enable_shell_telnet
methods.description: Registers the telnet shell backend during system init.

methods.name: shell_backend_telnet_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the telnet shell backend instance.
